reference_sql:
SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
    / SUM(budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id), 1) AS cumulative_share_pct
FROM budget_monthly
WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
alternatives:
SELECT b.channel_id, b.month, b.budget_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(b2.budget_eur) FROM budget_monthly b2
                 WHERE b2.channel_id = b.channel_id AND b2.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND b.month)
    / (SELECT SUM(b3.budget_eur) FROM budget_monthly b3
       WHERE b3.channel_id = b.channel_id AND b3.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'), 1) AS cumulative_share_pct
FROM budget_monthly b
WHERE b.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'

WITH y AS (
  -- one row per paid channel and month of 2025
  SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur
  FROM budget_monthly
  WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-01'
)
SELECT channel_id, month, budget_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
    / SUM(budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING), 1) AS cumulative_share_pct
FROM y
